notes:
Ported one .py per .go, named after the Go files. Both cloud modules are self-contained and deliberately duplicate Config/_join_url/_request, mirroring the two separate Go `cloud` packages; the webfetch default of "markdown", the always-set search Authorization header vs. the fetch-only-when-key-present one, and the exact error strings ("search request failed: 503 Service Unavailable", "web fetch failed: 404 Not Found: <body>") are preserved.

Missing types I defined: per-module service contracts as dataclasses plus typing.Protocol (websearch: SearchInput/SearchResult/SearchOutput + WebSearchService; webfetch: FetchOpts/Content/FetchResult + WebFetchService); wire payloads as SearchParameters/FetchParameters dataclasses serialized with dataclasses.asdict (snake_case JSON keys, all fields emitted including zero values, since the Go json tags aren't in these sources); CONTENT_WAS_NOT_FOUND = "Content was not found" (value guessed — the Go constant lives in the parent postprocessor package, noted in a comment); wire responses are consumed as parsed dicts rather than extra dataclasses, which is all the code needs.

Key judgment calls: Go's (value, error) returns became exceptions — ValueError for input validation, new WebSearchError/WebFetchError (RuntimeError subclasses) for HTTP failures; context.Context was dropped (no Python equivalent; timeouts belong on the injected session); New() constructors were dropped in favor of direct instantiation, with Config.http_client defaulting to requests.Session via field(default_factory=...) to mirror the nil-client fallback; Go's makeRequest/performRequest collapsed into one _request method since requests' session.post(url, json=..., headers=...) makes manual request building unidiomatic; url.JoinPath became a _join_url rstrip('/')-join helper; snippet_from_content keeps the same precedence (snippet > JSON string > {"text": ...} > serialized JSON).

Postprocessor: goquery + x/net/html/charset became BeautifulSoup("html.parser") — UnicodeDammit does the encoding sniffing, so the unused content-type plumbing went away (as did the unused http.Header param); the FNV-64 dedupe hash became a plain set[str] (identical observable dedupe); Go byte-length checks became character-length checks; length thresholds, selector lists, ordering (title > meta description > content), per-branch dedupe ordering, "Read more" skipping, and the code-vs-pre inline/fenced split are all preserved; added a body fallback to the whole soup for documents without a <body> (html.parser, unlike Go's html5 parser, doesn't synthesize one) and a .decomposed guard so nested noise elements don't crash decompose().

Verification: smoke-tested in a throwaway uv venv (beautifulsoup4 4.15, requests 2.34) with a stubbed session — extraction/dedup/noise-removal, snippet fallbacks, URL joining, validation and HTTP error paths all match. Formatting: uvx ruff format ran successfully ("3 files reformatted"); the default uv tool/cache dirs were sandbox-blocked, so I pointed UV_CACHE_DIR/UV_TOOL_DIR/UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR under /tmp/claude.
